sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining returns nil and silently stops the entire chain when any link is nil — the absence propagates automatically
sketches.resonance: Reaching for someone who is gone: each attempt to go deeper quietly collapses into nothing, without error, without complaint.

sketches.mechanism: A LEFT JOIN preserves every row from the left table even when no match exists on the right, filling unmatched columns with NULL
sketches.resonance: You show up to every meeting, but the other side is always empty — presence persists alongside absence.
sketches.draft:
SELECT me.day, you.reply
FROM calendar me
LEFT JOIN responses you
  ON me.day = you.day
-- every row returns
-- reply is always NULL

sketches.mechanism: An interface declares a method that must exist but provides no implementation — a promise of behavior with permanent emptiness
sketches.resonance: A contract to be whole that can never be fulfilled by the one who wrote it — completeness is always someone else's responsibility.
